{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp to fix an unintended copy of caller-supplied txdata in the C verification API",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.55,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Eliminating an unintended txdata copy across the kernel boundary provides an orders-of-magnitude speedup in verification benchmarks. Reviewer fametrano reported kernel API benchmarks showed 'orders-of-magnitude speedup by eliminating txdata copying' caused by ternary expression typing."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch mempool policy, data structures, or acceptance logic",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR does not modify mempool rules or behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to test files and fuzz harnesses are mechanical updates following the PrecomputedTransactionData constructor change",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Test modifications merely adapt existing test cases to the updated script interpreter API."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled Consensus and modifies PrecomputedTransactionData caching in src/script/interpreter.cpp and ConnectBlock() in src/validation.cpp",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Retires a hazard where sighash precomputations could be partially overwritten on repeated initialization. Enforcing construction-time initialization removes the flawed Init() guard that left BIP143 sighash caches vulnerable, and optimizes ConnectBlock() by avoiding txdata allocation when assumevalid skips script verification."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/psbt.cpp and src/wallet/feebumper.cpp are mechanical follow-ups to the PrecomputedTransactionData constructor change",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR touches wallet files only to update callers of PrecomputedTransactionData."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 1,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 0
  }
}
